title: Search and filter
summary: A pre-built composition combining a search input with filter chips to help users narrow down large data sets.
preamble: Search and filter combines an input, filter chips, and result list into a single, consistent pattern for exploring collections of data. It shows how components, behaviour, and guidelines work together to meet a common interface need.

overview.title: Usage
overview.section-content: Use the search and filter pattern whenever users need to explore or narrow down a larger collection of items, such as tables, lists, or grids of cards.
